verdict.rationale: vLLM has a first-party CLI documented at docs.vllm.ai/cli. It starts the OpenAI-compatible API server, prints TTFT and throughput stats after each response, and runs latency and throughput benchmarks. The core of the story, an official CLI, is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: the evidence shows only fragments of the CLI reference, with no machine-readable or scripting-oriented output (e.g. JSON) documented for agent-driven use, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.
